best_for: a process acted out step by step by generic people or roles (a kitchen team, a rescuer, the user and an attacker)
how a thing works when people, animals or cells carry the steps as roles
avoid_for: stories that need recurring, recognisable characters
signals: people in the script are roles, not named individuals
each beat is someone doing one step of the process
the beats are animation-led diagrams and line art
